definitions: A bridge spanning the River Seine in Paris, France, connecting the Eiffel Tower on the Left Bank to the Trocadéro Gardens on the Right Bank.
An iconic Parisian landmark known for its architectural significance and historical importance.
examples: Tourists often cross the Iena Bridge to get from the Eiffel Tower to the Trocadéro.
The Iena Bridge offers stunning views of the Seine and surrounding monuments.
The Iena Bridge was originally named Pont de l'École Militaire.
